title: Técnico(A) Instrumentação Iii
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up , o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Desafios


Liderar e executar atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, calibração, configuração e análise de falhas em instrumentos de medição, controle e automação nas áreas de Recuperação (caldeiras de recuperação, evaporadores, tratamento de gases) e Utilidades (caldeiras de força, turbinas, sistemas de tratamento de água, ar comprimido, vapor, gaseificação), atuando como referência técnica, desenvolvendo soluções avançadas, liderando equipes em intervenções complexas, garantindo a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança dos sistemas de instrumentação, seguindo planos, procedimentos e normas de segurança.


Principais Atividades


  • Atuação em manutenção preventiva e corretiva de instrumentos críticos, incluindo analisadores de gases e água, transmissores inteligentes, válvulas de controle, atuadores e sistemas de segurança (ESD e interlocks).
  • Diagnóstico e solução de falhas complexas com uso de ferramentas avançadas, análise de diagramas técnicos e históricos de falhas.
  • Execução de calibração, ajustes de alta precisão e parametrizações avançadas (HART, Fieldbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP).
  • Análise e otimização de malhas de controle complexas, como PID em cascata, controle preditivo e multivariável.
  • Liderança técnica em projetos de melhoria, comissionamento e testes de novos sistemas.
  • Elaboração de relatórios técnicos, registros em CMMS e análise de dados para melhoria contínua da manutenção.
  • Desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, com treinamento, mentoria e avaliação de profissionais de instrumentação.
  • Atuação rigorosa em segurança, meio ambiente, qualidade, ética e compliance.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Técnico em Instrumentação, Automação Industrial, Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Integração Segurança;
  • Ferramentas da qualidade;
  • Conhecimento emPacote Office e SAP;
  • Conhecimento avançado em instrumentação industrial (tipos de instrumentos de medição, transmissores analógicos e digitais, válvulas de controle, atuadores, posicionadores, sistemas de segurança);
  • Expertise Leitura e interpretação avançada de diagramas de instrumentação detalhados (malhas de controle complexas, diagramas lógicos, fiação e interligação);
  • Calibração de instrumentos de pressão, temperatura, vazão, nível e analisadores;
  • Configuração e parametrização de instrumentos inteligentes (HART, Fieldbus, Profibus) e sistemas de comunicação industrial;
  • Sistemas de controle (CLP, SDCD - programação básica, troubleshooting avançado, arquitetura de sistemas);
  • Normas de segurança do trabalho (NR-10) e normas técnicas de instrumentação;
  • CNH – Categoria“B”
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Inocência/MS
  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol, será um diferencial.


Se esse desafio conversa com a sua trajetória, este é o momento. Inscreva-se e venha fazer parte do Projeto Sucuriú — a grandeza que abraça.

title: Gerente De Vendas – Campo
description:

A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e promover a inovação na cadeia logística, resultado da união de duas empresas do setor: Fretefy e Pathfind. O Gerente de Vendas Campo será responsável por liderar, estruturar e escalar a atuação comercial externa da Mobiis, com forte presença junto a clientes e prospects estratégicos. A função terá como principal objetivo impulsionar a geração de receita direta, ampliar a presença da Mobiis em contas enterprise e mid-market e garantir previsibilidade comercial em mercados prioritários. Este papel é essencial para acelerar a adoção das soluções SaaS da Mobiis, atuando de forma próxima ao cliente, conectando estratégia, execução e relacionamento de longo prazo.


Resumo da Função

O(a) Gerente de Vendas Campo será responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a estratégia de vendas externas da Mobiis, liderando o time de vendedores em campo e atuando diretamente em negociações complexas e de alto valor. A função combina liderança comercial, atuação hands-on em campo e gestão de pipeline, com foco em crescimento sustentável, expansão de carteira, fechamento de grandes contratos e fortalecimento da marca Mobiis junto ao mercado logístico e de tecnologia.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Estratégia Comercial em Campo

- Definir e executar a estratégia de vendas externas, alinhada aos objetivos de crescimento da Mobiis.

- Estruturar territórios, rotas, prioridades e segmentos de atuação (mid-market e enterprise).

- Garantir execução consistente do plano comercial em campo, com foco em eficiência e resultado.


2. Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Fechamento

- Atuar diretamente na prospecção, negociação e fechamento de negócios estratégicos, especialmente em ciclos de venda mais complexos.

- Conduzir reuniões presenciais, apresentações executivas e negociações de alto impacto.

- Atuar como sponsor em contas-chave e projetos estratégicos.


3. Gestão e Desenvolvimento do Time de Vendas

- Liderar, desenvolver e acompanhar o desempenho do time de vendas externas.

- Definir metas, acompanhar indicadores e realizar feedbacks contínuos.

- Promover cultura de alta performance, disciplina comercial e foco em resultados.


4. Gestão de Pipeline, Receita e KPIs

- Garantir previsibilidade de receita por meio da gestão ativa do pipeline de vendas.

- Monitorar e reportar KPIs como:

- Receita gerada em campo

- Taxa de conversão por etapa do funil

- Ticket médio e ciclo de vendas

- Forecast accuracy

- Expansão e retenção de contas estratégicas


5. Relacionamento com Mercado e Interface Interna

- Atuar como representante da Mobiis junto a clientes estratégicos, eventos e encontros de mercado.

- Trabalhar de forma integrada com Pré-vendas, Marketing, Produto e Customer Success.

- Levar insights do mercado, concorrência e clientes para evolução da estratégia comercial e do portfólio.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

▪ Experiência sólida como Gerente de Vendas em Campo ou posições equivalentes em vendas externas.

▪ Forte atuação em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em tecnologia ou soluções complexas.

▪ Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes comerciais externas.

▪ Capacidade avançada de negociação, fechamento e relacionamento em nível executivo (C-level). ▪ Forte orientação a resultados, métricas e previsibilidade de receita.

▪ Experiência com CRM e metodologias de vendas consultivas.

▪ Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.


Requisitos Desejáveis

▪ Vivência em SaaS, tecnologia logística ou cadeia de suprimentos (TMS, WMS, YMS, OMS, Torre de Controle).

▪ Experiência em vendas de soluções de alto valor agregado e contratos de longo prazo.

▪ Inglês intermediário/avançado.

▪ Experiência em estratégias de expansão de contas.

▪ Perfil analítico, estratégico e com forte presença em campo.


A Quem Ele Deve se Reportar

O Gerente de Vendas Campo se reportará diretamente ao Diretor de Vendas e Estratégia Comercial, atuando de forma integrada com Marketing, Pré-vendas, Produto e Customer Success.


Objetivo Principal do Cargo

O principal objetivo deste cargo é impulsionar a receita direta da Mobiis por meio de uma atuação comercial forte em campo, garantindo crescimento sustentável, expansão da base de clientes estratégicos e alta previsibilidade de resultados, fortalecendo a posição da Mobiis como referência em soluções SaaS para logística em 2026 e além.

title: Salesforce Analyst
description:

RevBlack is not for everyone. It’s for the curious, fast learners who take ownership and thrive on high standards. We work hard, move fast, and deliver work that makes a difference. If you’re seeking an easy job, this isn’t it. But if you’re ready to push your limits and grow, we want you.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil


REPortS TO:

R&D Manager


Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.


Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.


Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.G., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.


Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About You

You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined.

You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.

  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
  • Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).

  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Operações para atuar na liderança e gestão de projetos, sendo responsável pelo planejamento, controle e execução de projetos industriais, navais e de óleo e gás, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, custos, qualidade, segurança e requisitos contratuais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, atualizar e garantir a execução do Plano de Execução do Projeto (PEP), abrangendo escopo, cronograma, orçamento, qualidade, QSMS e interfaces;
  • Planejar e controlar cronogramas detalhados (nível 3 ou 4), assegurando cumprimento do caminho crítico, alocação eficiente de recursos e mitigação de riscos;
  • Gerenciar custos, produtividade, riscos, mudanças e previsões financeiras, promovendo cultura de controle e melhoria contínua;
  • Liderar equipesmultidisciplinares (soldagem, elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, inspeção, NDT, estruturas, entre outras), promovendo engajamento, desenvolvimento e alta performance;
  • Gerenciar mobilizações, logística, materiais, equipamentos e certificações, garantindo prontidão operacional e compliance;
  • Assegurar a execução das atividades conforme procedimentos, desenhos, CTRs, normas técnicas e melhores práticas do setor;
  • Gerir equipes próprias e subcontratadas em atividades de construção, reparos, IMR e comissionamento;
  • Validar MTOs, garantindo aderência ao escopo, quantidades, especificações técnicas e rastreabilidade de materiais;
  • Monitorar progresso físico, produtividade e KPIs das frentes de trabalho, propondo ações corretivas quando necessário;
  • Garantir conformidade com as Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35, requisitos IACS, ABS, DNV e exigências dos clientes;
  • Implementar planos de qualidade e inspeção, gerenciar NCRs, testes, inspeções e punch lists
  • Liderar análises de risco e HAZIDs, garantindo a aplicação de medidas de controle em campo
  • Atuar como ponto focal operacional junto ao cliente, assegurando alinhamento e comunicação eficaz;
  • Conduzir reuniões, auditorias e inspeções técnicas e operacionais;
  • Emitir relatórios semanais e mensais com indicadores de prazo, custo, QSMS, progresso e produtividade;
  • Registrar evolução de escopo, desvios e justificativas;
  • Conduzir sessões de lições aprendidas e implementar melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter alinhamento constante com a área Comercial quanto a impactos operacionais e execução conforme escopo contratado.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Naval, Elétrica, Produção, Petróleo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos na área ou em função similar;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos EPC e IMR;
  • Vivência em projetos industriais, navais ou de óleo e gás;
  • Sólida experiência em planejamento, controle de custos, análise de produtividade e gestão de grandes equipes;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Conhecimento em metodologia EPC e gestão de projetos industriais;
  • Experiência comMS Project ou Primavera;
  • Conhecimento emERP (TOTVS/Fluig), plataformas de gestão de projetos e dashboards de BI;
  • Conhecimento das Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35;
  • Conhecimento dos requisitos IACS, ABS e DNV.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência em projetos para a Petrobras;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Microsoft Office (Word, Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Conhecimentos avançados em gestão e melhoria de processos.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About You

You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined.

You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms.
  • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.
  • Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage.
  • Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
  • Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners.
  • Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests.
  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
  • Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
  • Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.


Qualifications

  • Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Title : Director - Regional CMC

Location : Brazil, Remote

Experience : Min 15 years in Regulatory Affairs, CMC


Director – Regional CMC

Objective:

The Director – Regional CMC will manage the Regional CMC team, ensuring seamless integration between global Regulatory CMC strategies and local affiliate execution. This role is pivotal in driving regional alignment, efficiency, and consistency in post-approval submissions across a diverse product portfolio, including small molecules, biologics, vaccines, and plasma-derived therapies. The Director – Regional CMC will champion the development and implementation of regional strategies, fostering collaboration and process improvement to meet regulatory requirements effectively and efficiently.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage the Regional CMC team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high performance and professional development.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
  • Develop and execute a strategic vision for the Regional CMC Liaison function, aligning with global Regulatory CMC objectives.
  • Ensure the team is equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge, and resources to excel in their roles.
  • Translate global CMC strategies into comprehensive regional plans, ensuring alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of regional submission strategies to streamline processes and reduce duplication of effort.
  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to identify opportunities for harmonization and efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on submission timelines and regulatory approvals, addressing any issues or delays proactively.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local affiliates to understand and address country-specific regulatory needs and challenges.
  • Liaise with global Regulatory CMC teams to provide regional insights and feedback, ensuring a cohesive approach to regulatory submissions.
  • Represent the Regional CMC Liaison function in cross-functional and global meetings, advocating for regional needs and perspectives.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks in the regional submission process, proposing and implementing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices and lessons learned to optimize regional submission processes.
  • Ensure compliance with regional and country-specific regulatory requirements and guidelines.


Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):

  • BS/BA Degree in a Scientific Discipline, Advanced Degree (M.S), with Ph.D. preferred.
  • 15+ years of seasoned biopharmaceutical/device industry experience or with a regulatory agency is preferred, while leading major submissions during LCM, development - including preparation of NDA/NLA/MAA.
  • Equivalent industry experience with direct technical/product development experience such as Pharmaceutical Development, Analytical Development, Production, Quality Assurance can be considered.
  • People leadership experience (5+ years) required.
  • Highly proficient understanding of scientific principles and profound grasp of global regulatory CMC requirements relevant to global drug development and post-market support.
  • Keeping abreast of industry insights and regulatory trends to drive organizational evolution.
  • Proven ability to understand and communicate regulatory strategy to drug development, registration, and post-market support teams.
  • Analyze issues with attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess and scientifically justify alternative approaches.
  • Base regulatory strategy recommendations on precedents and other regulatory intelligence as well as regulations and guidelines.
  • Able to deal with issues of critical importance independently.
  • Exercises excellent judgment in elevating and communicating actual or potential issues to line management.
  • Understands who is responsible for different decisions, drives and escalates as necessary.
  • Implements the directions taken by the company, leading with agility through evolving landscapes.
  • Intentionally promotes an inclusive culture, leveraging individual strengths for team success.
  • Develops and drives prioritization framework, managing shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional skills in written and oral communication.
  • Demonstrates excellent skills in leadership, collaboration, negotiation, problem solving, and fostering interpersonal connections through teamwork.

title: It Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

title: Microsoft Dynamics Developer
description:

You are a technically strong Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Developer who enjoys building, customizing, and integrating enterprise-grade ERP solutions. About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Gerente De Projetos
description:
Gestão de Projetos de Onboarding (Implementação de Clientes)

Local: São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (3x por semana presencial ) nas proximidades da Estação Berrini (CENU)

Regime de contratação: CLT


Sobre a ColmeIA

A ColmeIA é referência nacional em aceleração digital. Atuamos como parceiro oficial da Meta , entregando soluções de comunicação omnichannel com IA, automação e analytics avançado .

Nossa cultura é baseada em autonomia, colaboração e velocidade de entrega — o que o mercado faz em meses, fazemos em dias. Buscamos profissionais que queiram atuar em um ambiente técnico exigente, com projetos de impacto real em grandes marcas.


Benefícios que fazem a diferença

Aqui, valorizamos o bem-estar e o desenvolvimento das nossas pessoas. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote completo de benefícios pensado para proporcionar qualidade de vida, reconhecimento e crescimento profissional:

  • Ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e colaborativo, que valoriza pessoas e boas relações
  • Modelo híbrido: 3 dias presenciais no escritório e 2 dias em home office
  • Auxílio-creche para crianças de 03 a 60 meses (conforme regras vigentes)
  • Bicicletário no condomínio , com estrutura segura para sua bike e banho disponível
  • Bradesco Odonto Prime
  • Bradesco Saúde , acomodação em apartamento e cobertura nacional
  • Desconto fixo de apenas R$ 1,00 para qualquer benefício oferecido
  • Flash Benefícios no valor fixo de R$ 1.000,00 mensais
  • Licença-maternidade acolhedora , com manutenção do Flash Benefícios durante todo o período de afastamento
  • Plataforma de cursos Alura , para desenvolvimento profissional contínuo
  • Seguro de Vida
  • TotalPass , categoria TP4 totalmente gratuita
  • Vale Transporte , proporcional à quantidade de dias presenciais
  • Vagas de estacionamento disponíveis para colaboradores que optarem por não utilizar o vale-transporte
  • Parceria SESI, SESC e SENAI


Sobre a vaga

Resumo da posição

Será o ponto focal para a coordenação e garantia de sucesso dos projetos de implementação (onboarding) de novos clientes e das iniciativas de desenvolvimento de produto da plataforma ColmeIA.

Este profissional é crucial em nossa estratégia de curto tempo de implementação e de evolução contínua de produto/jornada, que se baseia em arquitetura modular, IA e integração multicanal (WhatsApp, e-mail, etc.).

O papel exige:

  • Forte capacidade de comunicação
  • Experiência de contato direto com cliente
  • Gestão de stakeholders
  • Profundo entendimento do ciclo de vida de projetos de software
  • Experiência com implantação de soluções B2B SaaS (Software as a Service)


Responsabilidades


Planejamento e Escopo

  • Apoiar e acompanhar o Analista de Negócios no detalhamento do escopo de cada projeto de onboarding, em linha com o que foi acordado com as equipes de Vendas
  • Traduzir as necessidades do cliente em requisitos técnicos e de automação


Execução e Monitoramento

  • Gerenciar cronograma, recursos e alocação de horas dos projetos em implementação
  • Utilizar metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban ) para acompanhar o progresso da equipe de onboarding
  • Garantir visibilidade do andamento para o cliente e áreas envolvidas


Gestão de Riscos

  • Identificar proativamente gargalos e riscos que possam atrasar a entrega ou comprometer a qualidade da solução implementada
  • Atuar preventivamente e apoiar a resolução de problemas, como:
  • atraso na entrega de conteúdo pelo cliente
  • problemas de integração relatados pelos desenvolvedores do projeto


Qualidade e Entrega

  • Assegurar que a solução entregue esteja em conformidade com os requisitos definidos
  • Garantir que os fluxos de automação atendam corretamente às regras de negócio


Transição

  • Coordenar a transição do projeto de onboarding para a equipe de Suporte
  • Garantir que a documentação e as métricas iniciais de performance estejam claras e organizadas


Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades

A ColmeIA valoriza a diversidade e oferece igualdade de oportunidades em seus processos seletivos.

Atenção: apenas candidatos nível Sênior , com boa pontuação no teste online , serão considerados aptos para seguir no processo.


Processo Seletivo

Nosso objetivo é garantir uma avaliação justa, transparente e baseada exclusivamente nos conhecimentos reais de cada candidato.

Será considerado aprovado para a próxima etapa o candidato que atingir pontuação mínima de 70% no teste Coderbyte , sem identificação de irregularidades durante a execução.


Etapas do processo seletivo

  1. Triagem inicial de perfil, competências e análise das respostas enviadas através do LinkedIn
  2. Teste técnico online (Coderbyte)
  • Link enviado por e-mail a todos os candidatos triados na etapa anterior
  • Pontuação mínima exigida: 70%
  • Verificação de integridade durante a execução
  1. Entrevista online com RH e responsáveis pela área


Importante: informação sobre o teste online

O teste deverá ser realizado sem acesso a qualquer ferramenta de consulta externa , como:

  • Google, ChatGPT, Gemini ou similares

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • Atleast 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.G., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role;
experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.G., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.

  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.

  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - Latam
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

description:

- Implementar e automatizar regras de negócio diretamente na origem, estruturando cálculos e tratamentos para eliminar ajustes manuais no Power Query.

- Criar dashboards executivos e operacionais no Power BI com alto padrão visual, storytelling e melhores práticas de UX/UI.

- Desenvolver medidas avançadas em DAX para análises complexas, incluindo KPIs de mídia como Year-over-Year, Share of Voice e indicadores acumulados.

- Realizar manutenção evolutiva de relatórios existentes, assegurando consistência técnica e visual conforme novas demandas do negócio surgirem.

- Conduzir análises e troubleshooting ponta a ponta, investigando divergências desde medidas DAX até queries SQL no Data Lake.

- Gerenciar governança dos workspaces no Power BI Service, incluindo organização de publicações, controle de acessos e atualização de datasets.


Requisitos


- Power BI em nível intermediário, com domínio de linguagem DAX, conhecimento em Power Query (M) e forte experiência em modelagem de dados (relacionamentos, cardinalidade, desempenho e otimização de datasets).

- SQL em nível intermediário/avançado, com habilidade para escrever queries complexas, incluindo CTEs e Window Functions, para manipulação de dados e validação de regras de negócio.

- Experiência intermediária com Databricks e PySpark, incluindo uso de notebooks, leitura de tabelas Delta e manipulação básica de DataFrames (filtro, agregações e tratamentos via código).

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect


Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.


The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:


As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:


TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR


DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns


DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models


Knowledge and Experience


ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English


DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Operador De Caldeira Eta/Ete
description:
Operar o sistema de produção de vapor na Casa de Caldeiras, o sistema de recuperação de fibras e clarificação dos efluentes, e o sistema de tratamento de água industrial


Conhecimentos e Habilidades Técnicas:


  • Conhecimentos ISO 90001
  • Informática (Pacote Office)
  • Habilitação de operador de caldeira de acordo com a NR 13
  • Ensino Médio
  • Curso Técnico em Química ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial
  • Residir em Limeira, Americana e Santa Bárbara d'Oeste


Atribuições:

· Controlar o funcionamento geral da caldeira, através do supervisório a leitura constante dos medidores de pressão, nível de água, temperatura, etc.

· Controlar através do supervisório da sala de operação o nível do reservatório de água de alimentação e também da caldeira;

· Controlar o tempo da descarga de fundo e nível sempre que necessário;

· Acionar mecânicos/eletricistas para reparos quando necessário;

· Informarao supervisor de turno eventuais quedas de pressão;

· Fazer a limpeza na área de trabalho uma vez por turno ou sempre que necessário;

· Fazer uso e zelar dos meios de produção, bem como, das normas e equipamentos de segurança fornecidos pela empresa

· Controlar o sistema de Recuperação de fibras.

· Controlar dosagem da bomba de alimentação de floculante quando necessário, a fim de manter a qualidade da água clarificada.

· Encaminhar a massa recuperada para o processo de preparação de massa, bem como parte da água clarificada ao processo industrial.

· Operar o sistema de tratamento de água industrial.

· Fazer controle da bomba de dosagem de coagulante quando necessário, controlando a qualidade da água fresca a ser encaminhada para o processo industrial.

· Controlar as variáveis de processo (amperagem das bombas de alimentação e recalque, sólidos sedimentáveis, controle de pH, dosagem de coagulante, e anti-espumante, coletas de amostras para análises de controle do processo).

· Realizar teste de abertura de válvulas de segurança;

· Realizaro abastecimento da caldeira biomassa com lenha e controlar oxigênio e pressão de trabalho;

· Preencher planilhas de controle e relatório operacional;

· Inspecionar equipamentos (ventiladores, bombas e etc);

· Direcionar tambor de cinza em caçamba

· Emitir relatórios relativos à qualidade e controle do processo


Benefícios:


  • Plano de saúde
  • Refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • Transporte Fretado
  • Seguro de vida em grupo
  • Wellhub
  • PLR
  • Auster (Programa de Apoio Psicológico)

title: Trainee Agronomo
description:

Suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o manejo e a produção de plantas ornamentais
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de mudas, adubação, irrigação e controle fitossanitário
  • Contribuir na implementação de melhorias e inovações agronômicas

  • Formação superior completa nas áreas de Técnico Agrícola, Biólogo, Engenheiro Florestal, Engenheiro Agrônomo (preferencialmente recém-formados)

Se você quer construir uma carreira sólida e tem paixão por fazer o mundo mais verde e bonito, venha crescer com a gente!

Envie seu currículo para , com o assunto “Trainee Agrônomo – Spagnhol Plantas” , e conte um pouco sobre o que te motiva nesse universo.

title: Analista De Processo De Manufatura Pleno
description:
Este é o Grupo Husqvarna, o maior produtor mundial de produtos de energia ao ar livre para silvicultura, gramado e jardim e construção. Como uma das start-ups mais antigas do mundo, estamos em uma jornada emocionante, trabalhando juntos em um ambiente global acelerado, onde nos desafiamos continuamente a continuar inovando e reinventando nossos negócios.

Com nossa paixão pela inovação, criamos produtos e serviços para clientes em todo o mundo. Somos um empregador de oportunidades iguais e entendemos que nossas diferenças são nossos pontos fortes. Somos curiosos, ousados e construídos por nossas diferenças. Celebramos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os funcionários e candidatos. Juntos como uma equipe, podemos dar vida às melhores ideias.

Hoje, o Grupo está com uma oportunidade como Analista em Processos de Manufatura que pode ser a sua cara, confira abaixo:

O escopo da função é de principalmente apoiar no processo de expansão da planta com o desenho e estruturação de processos de produção das novas linhas de montagem.


O que você vai fazer:

Será responsável pelos processos e projetos de todas as linhas de montagem (assembly lines) da nossa manufatura: executar simulações, gerenciar restrições de custo e tempo e realizar avaliações de risco;

Realização de cronoanálise: determinar quanto tempo e esforços são necessários para a execução de cada tarefa na linha;

Análise de tempose métodos: análise de tempos e movimentos em nossa linha de produção, com o objetivo de otimizar processos e eliminar desperdícios;

Desenvolvimento emelhoria de padrões de trabalho/instruções técnicas/procedimentos operacionais;

Atualização e confecção de documentações técnicas da nossa manufatura;

Realização do controle dimensional: verificar de modo eficiente as características dimensionais de peças, subconjuntos ou equipamentos, de modo a garantir a montagem, o bom funcionamento, a manutenção e a intercambiabilidade de peças e componentes;

Desenvolver, executar, testar e atualizar sistemas e processos;

Desenvolver melhores práticas, rotinas e soluções inovadoras para melhorar as taxas de produção e a qualidade dos resultados;

Estudar e compreender processos e melhores práticas existentes em outras plantas da Husqvarna pelo mundo e trazer/adaptar para o Brasil.

O que é importante você saber:

Formação superior em engenharia (preferencialmente mecânica ou produção);

Ter inglês avançado (B2) (conversação e escrita) para visitas, chamadas/conferências e reuniões/apresentações com times internacionais;

Experiência prévia como processista em indústrias correlatas (automotiva, linha branca etc);

Excelentes habilidades técnicas, raciocínio analítico com habilidades interpessoais;

title: Veterinário
description:
Vaga: Médico(a) Veterinário(a) – Criação de Conteúdo | GomaPet

Estamos buscando um(a) Médico(a) Veterinário(a) apaixonado(a) por saúde animal para integrar nossa equipe e colaborar na criação de conteúdos educativos e científicos para o *GomaPet*, nosso suplemento inovador em formato de goma que promove saúde intestinal e bem-estar em cães.

  • Paixão pela área de nutrição e saúde animal.
  • Habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita, com facilidade para traduzir termos técnicos em linguagem acessível.
  • Experiência em produção de conteúdo digital será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em marketing de conteúdo ou mídias sociais é desejável, mas não obrigatório.

✨ Por que se juntar a nós?

  • Oportunidade de participar de um projeto inovador no mercado pet.
  • Atuar em uma empresa que valoriza ciência, bem-estar e impacto positivo.
  • Fazer parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, com liberdade criativa e espaço para crescimento.

title: Motorista De Ônibus
description:
Descrição

A Aliança Tur, empresa com mais de 25 anos de experiência no transporte rodoviário de passageiros, certificada pela ISO 9001:2015, está contratando Motorista de Ônibus para atuar em operações de fretamento corporativo em áreas de mineração no estado do Pará.

Buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a segurança, pontualidade e atendimento de qualidade, que contribuam para manter o padrão de excelência que diferencia a Aliança Tur no transporte de colaboradores de grandes empresas do setor mineral.


Responsabilidades
  • Realizar o transporte diário de colaboradores de mineradoras entre unidades operacionais e alojamentos;
  • Conduzir o veículo com segurança, responsabilidade e atenção total às normas de trânsito e de segurança da Vale;
  • Cumprir rigorosamente horários e rotas estabelecidas;
  • Fazer a checagem diária das condições do veículo antes das viagens (óleo, pneus, luzes, freios etc.);
  • Comunicar falhas ou ocorrências ao setor de tráfego/manutenção;
  • Manter o veículo limpo e organizado;
  • Adotar conduta profissional e cordial, representando a empresa junto aos clientes e passageiros;
  • Participar de treinamentos de segurança e reciclagens periódicas exigidas pelas mineradoras.


Qualificações
  • CNH categoria D ou E, com curso de transporte coletivo de passageiros atualizado;
  • Experiência comprovada como motorista de ônibus em fretamento corporativo ou áreas industriais/mineradoras;
  • Conhecimento emdireção defensiva e mecânica preventiva básica;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuar em escala (inclusive noturna, se necessário);
  • Comprometimentocom segurança, disciplina e pontualidade;
  • Desejável: experiência prévia em operações Vale.


A Aliança Tur oferece remuneração compatível com o mercado e pacote de benefícios comunicados na entrevista.

description:

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Regional Sales Manager (RSM)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Company: Hanwha Vision

Department: Sales

Work Model: Field-based / On-site with travel


About Hanwha Vision


Hanwha Vision is a global leader in video surveillance and security solutions, part of the Hanwha Group. We develop advanced technologies that help create safer, smarter environments across industries such as retail, transportation, critical infrastructure, and smart cities.


As part of our continued growth in Latin America, we are seeking a Regional Sales Manager (RSM) based in São Paulo, Brazil , to drive revenue growth and market expansion for our video surveillance and security solutions across the assigned territory.


Key Responsibilities


Sales Planning and Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales plan for the assigned region.
  • Identify and develop strategic system integrators with tailored growth plans.
  • Execute regional action plans aligned with the company’s overall sales strategy.


Relationship Management

  • Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with system integrators, distributors, and key end customers.
  • Conduct regular meetings with strategic accounts to understand needs and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Generate demand through large end users in collaboration with consultants, engineers, architects, and technology partners.


Sales Support and Execution

  • Provide expert guidance on Hanwha Vision products and solutions.
  • Deliver sales presentations, both in-person and virtually, to promote the product portfolio.
  • Support integrators in solution design, proposal development, deal closure, and project execution.
  • Prepare and manage quotations, ensuring timely and accurate product delivery.


Order Coordination and Logistics

  • Coordinate with internal teams and distributors to ensure accurate and timely order processing.
  • Monitor order status and proactively resolve any issues.


Market Analysis and Strategic Development

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of customers, opportunities, market trends, and competitors.
  • Conduct market research to identify growth opportunities and risks.
  • Develop strategies to increase market share and achieve regional sales targets.


Performance Monitoring and Reporting

  • Analyze sales performance metrics and forecast regional revenue.
  • Prepare regular reports on sales activities, pipeline, and results.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the CRM system.


Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Technical Support teams to align initiatives.
  • Coordinate with the STEP program to ensure system integrators maintain certifications and receive appropriate training.
  • Provide strategic market feedback to senior management to support product and marketing development.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar sales role within the technology, electronic security, or video surveillance industry.
  • Proven experience working with system integrators and distributors .
  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (mandatory).
  • Strong negotiation skills, strategic thinking, results-driven mindset, and customer orientation.
  • Availability to travel within Brazil and the region as required.


What We Offer

  • The opportunity to join a global leader in video surveillance technology.
  • High-impact regional role with strategic autonomy.
  • Professional growth within an international organization.
